verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents 'built-in support for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, and BrowserUse agents' (model-native agents) and can return screenshots via fetch/scrape APIs, hinting at vision-capable agent modes, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'vision' or 'computer-use' action mode that operates purely on screenshots for canvases/UIs the DOM can't reach. Missing for 10: explicit computer-use/vision mode docs, screenshot-based click/type action primitives, and any example of handling canvas/non-DOM UI elements.
